THFL 100.title: The Art of Storytelling for Stage and Screen
THFL 100.description: Fundamental elements of the art of storytelling as approached within each of the core areas taught in the Department of Theatre and Film: Acting/Directing, Design and Production, and Film Production. Restricted to students in one of the following BFA programs: Major in Acting; Major in Film Production; Major in Theatre Design and Production

THFL 200.title: Visual Narrative: Exploring Design and Creative Process
THFL 200.description: Visual storytelling, combining practical design techniques with creative methodologies. Uses design principles to shape visual narratives by emphasizing innovative visual communication and a thorough understanding of the creative process.

THFL 226.title: Celebrity Studies
THFL 226.description: Critical analysis of global celebrity in the performing arts.

THFL 304.title: Production Design
THFL 304.description: The tools and processes used by set designers, art directors, and production designers in North America.

THFL 312.title: Expanded Visual Media
THFL 312.description: Pre- and/or post-production strategies, techniques, and processes for time-based media effects.
THFL 312.prerequisiteText: One of VISA 241, VISA 210, FIPR 133, FIPR 233. Or B.M.S. students with 3rd year standing

THFL 402.title: Professional Portfolio Preparation for Live and Digital Performance
THFL 402.description: Preparation to transition into the theatre and film industry. Portfolio development, visual identity, and skills to support professional performance practices aligned with theatre and film professional associations. Restricted to students in third or fourth-year in one of the following programs: Major in Film Production; Major in Theatre Design and Production.
THFL 402.prerequisiteText: One of THTR 305, THTR 306, THTR 307, THTR 308, FIPR 333

THFL 599.title: Production
THFL 599.description: Assigned projects in Theatre and Film design and production. Restricted to students in the MFA THTR and MFA FIPR programs.
